allow:
git status --short && printf '
wordpress tree:
' && find scripts/wordpress -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && printf '
profile contents:
' && for f in scripts/wordpress/profiles/*; do echo "--- $f"; cat "$f"; done

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('scripts/wordpress/bootstrap.sh')
s = p.read_text()
start = s.index('mark_maker_core_packages() {')
end = s.index('register_site_host() {', start)
p.write_text(s[:start] + s[end:])
PY
rm -f \
 scripts/wordpress/audit-maker.sh scripts/wordpress/audit-maker.test.sh \
 scripts/wordpress/migrate-maker.sh scripts/wordpress/migrate-maker.test.sh \
 scripts/wordpress/release-maker.sh scripts/wordpress/release-maker.test.sh \
 scripts/wordpress/sync-maker.sh scripts/wordpress/sync-maker.test.sh \
 scripts/wordpress/MAKER-RELEASES.md scripts/wordpress/MIGRATE-MAKER-SITES.md \
 scripts/wordpress/maker-stack.json scripts/wordpress/maker-stack.schema.json \
 scripts/wordpress/profiles/maker-stack.fragment
